verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a bare 'ESS reporting' line item on the pricing page. That points to support for a non-US employee share scheme regime, but the docs do not explain it. All other valuation evidence is the US 409A. missing for 10: UK HMRC/EMI valuation support, EMI or other country-specific option plan documentation, an explanation of what ESS reporting covers and for which jurisdiction, multi-jurisdiction entity scheme handling, independent corroboration.
